before.source:
Conjures up a bolt of fire, setting the target ablaze and doing %0.2f fire damage over 3 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
before.target:
召唤一枚火焰箭，点燃目标，并在 3 回合内造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

translation_revisions.adjudication: The target presents %0.2f as the total fire damage occurring within three turns and does not describe it as damage per turn.

before.source:
Fills the air around you with reactive currents of furnace-like heat.
		If you have a gem or mindstar in your psionically wielded slot, this will do %0.1f Fire damage to all adjacent enemies, costing %0.1f energy per creature. 
		If you have a conventional weapon in your psionically wielded slot, this will add %0.1f Fire damage to all your weapon hits, costing %0.1f energy per hit.
		When deactivated, if you have at least %d energy, a massive spike of thermal energy is released as a conical blast (radius %d) of superheated air. Anybody caught in it will suffer up to %d fire damage over several turns.
		#{bold}#Activating the aura takes no time but de-activating it does.#{normal}#
		To turn off an aura without spiking it, deactivate it and target yourself. The damage will improve with your Mindpower.
		You can only have two of these auras active at once.
before.target:
将你周围的空气充满火炉般的热量。
		如果你的灵能武器槽佩戴的是宝石或灵晶，会对所有接近的目标造成 %0.1f 的火焰伤害，每个生物消耗 %0.1f 能量。
		如果你的灵能武器槽佩戴的是武器，每次攻击附加 %0.1f 的火焰伤害，每次攻击消耗 %0.1f 能量。
		当关闭该技能时，如果你拥有最少 %d 点能量，巨大的热能会释放为一个范围为 %d 的锥形冲击。范围内的任意目标在数轮中受到高达 %d 的火焰伤害。
		#{bold}#激活光环是不消耗时间的，但是关闭它则需要消耗时间。#{normal}#
		如果要关闭光环且不发射射线，关闭它并选择你自己为目标。伤害随着精神强度而增长。
		你同时只能激活两种此类光环。

将你周围的空气充满火炉般的热量。
		如果你的灵能武器槽佩戴的是宝石或灵晶，会对所有相邻的敌人造成 %0.1f 的火焰伤害，每个生物消耗 %0.1f 能量。
		如果你的灵能武器槽佩戴的是武器，每次武器命中时附加 %0.1f 的火焰伤害，每次命中消耗 %0.1f 能量。

translation_revisions.adjudication: Repaired CTX-R0-001, CTX-R0-002, CTX-R1-001, CTX-R2-001, and CTX-R2-002: the target explicitly limits the normal aura effect to adjacent enemies, describes self-targeted deactivation as suppressing the thermal-energy spike, binds the added fire damage and energy cost to each successful weapon hit, and identifies %d as the cone radius. CTX-R1-002 remains advisory/no-change: the Chinese retains the English surface wording '最少 %d 点能量'. The upper-bound total-over-several-turns wording remains unchanged.

translation_revisions.adjudication: The target presents %0.2f as total damage within three turns and accurately exposes the level-5 change from a stopping bolt to a penetrating beam.

files.runtime_expression: self:projectile(tg, x, y, DamageType.FIREBURN, self:spellCrit(t.getDamage(self, t)), callback)
self:project(tg, x, y, DamageType.FIREBURN, self:mindCrit(rng.avg(0.8*dam, dam)))

spike_cost_semantics.tooltip_surface: The %d placeholder displays the numeric argument as 6.
spike_cost_semantics.runtime_guard: if self:getPsi() <= cost then return true without producing a spike
spike_cost_semantics.runtime_consequence: A spike requires psi > 6.6667 approximately, despite the tooltip surface displaying 6.

files.runtime_expression: dam = thaumaturgyBeamDamage(self, self:spellCrit(t.getDamage(self, t))); each of the widebeam, sub-level-5 bolt, and level-5 beam branches passes dam to DamageType.FIREBURN

files.expression: archmage_beam_dam_mult absent -> dam; otherwise dam * (1 + archmage_beam_dam_mult / 100)

runtime_value_flow.tooltip_quantity: Uncritical t.getDamage base after FIRE damDesc display conversion.
runtime_value_flow.action_quantity: self:spellCrit(t.getDamage(self, t)) supplies the complete FIREBURN event scalar.
runtime_value_flow.relationship: A runtime spell critical can change the applied scalar relative to the displayed base under normal tooltip/action conventions.

runtime_value_flow.tooltip_quantity: The displayed final %d is the uncritical upper bound t.getAuraSpikeStrength(self, t), after FIRE damDesc display conversion.
runtime_value_flow.action_quantity: self:mindCrit(rng.avg(0.8*dam, dam)) supplies a random value from 80% through 100% of dam, then applies the runtime mind-critical adjustment, as the complete FIREBURN event scalar.
runtime_value_flow.relationship: The translation's '高达' matches the pre-critical random upper-bound display; runtime RNG and a mind critical may change the actually applied scalar.

runtime_value_flow.tooltip_quantity: Uncritical t.getDamage base after FIRE damDesc display conversion.
runtime_value_flow.action_quantity: thaumaturgyBeamDamage(self, self:spellCrit(t.getDamage(self, t))) supplies the complete FIREBURN event scalar to every branch.
runtime_value_flow.relationship: A runtime spell critical and, when present, archmage_beam_dam_mult can change the applied scalar relative to the displayed base; the thaumaturgy multiplier is identity when that attribute is absent.

scalar_defaults.unmerged_nominal_total: 50% immediate FIRE plus three nominal EFF_BURNING timeouts at dam/6 sum to the incoming scalar dam before downstream mitigation; the scalar is not a per-turn amount.

damage_type_semantics.critical_state_note: FIREBURN initializes projection state and calls useImplicitCrit, while these sampled actions already supply their explicit action-time spellCrit or mindCrit values. This record binds the observed tooltip-to-action expressions without claiming a second independent critical roll.

burning_merge_qualification.conservation: The old remaining damage and incoming remaining burn damage are combined before downstream mitigation.
burning_merge_qualification.wording_consequence: The translations describe each newly applied total over its nominal duration; they do not promise an isolated tick value or an unchanged standalone three-turn schedule after an existing burn merges.

adjudication.thermal_aura: repaired for CTX-R0-001, CTX-R0-002, CTX-R1-001, CTX-R2-001, and CTX-R2-002; CTX-R1-002 remains advisory/no-change; scalar and upper-bound wording remain adequate

finding_lineage.origin: cycle-1 contextual re-review and senior scope audit
finding_lineage.evidence: Cycle 2 bound the added damage to weapon attacks with 每次武器攻击附加 while leaving 每次攻击消耗 unchanged; CTX-R2-001 subsequently refined both phrases in Cycle 3 to state the successful-hit relationship explicitly.

finding_lineage.origin: cycle-1 contextual re-review, narrowed by senior scope audit
finding_lineage.evidence: At fixed projection.lua, sustain_psi=10 and cost=10*2/3=6.6667; %d displays 6, and psi <= cost produces no spike. The Chinese 最少 %d 点能量 faithfully mirrors the English surface, while the translation layer cannot accurately express the hidden fractional threshold.
Fixed projection.lua invokes the aura combat effect only after attackTargetWith reports a successful conventional-weapon hit; the target now explicitly says 每次武器命中时 and binds the energy cost to 每次命中.
The fixed source declares a cone target with radius=6 and the English tooltip labels the %d extent as radius; the target now says 半径为 %d while preserving the placeholder position.

out_of_scope_follow_up_observations.subject: Kinetic Aura and Charged Aura weapon-hit wording
out_of_scope_follow_up_observations.statement: The sibling Kinetic Aura and Charged Aura targets use the same generalized 每次攻击附加 wording for English all your weapon hits. They are outside the frozen workset and were not modified.
